scope: Mac single-CPU native Linux with translated ARM64 Android; services and desktop functional checks; iPhone execution unverified

lkl-translation-cache-capacity.scope: Native single-CPU LKL with translated ARM64 userspace; selected workload only; iPhone unverified
lkl-translation-cache-capacity.measurement: Guest clock times 128 pipe round trips per memory case; excludes initial COW materialization. Selected preemption, translation and selected Linux mapping implementation included. Memory means are arithmetic sample means, including phase boundaries; sampled peaks can miss short peaks. Resident lifetime peak is separate.
